links.outcome: Readability (reading grade and text complexity metrics) and sentiment of report impressions
links.effect: Reading grade fell from approximately college to approximately middle-school level; readability improved across several text complexity metrics; simplified impressions were classified as more neutral and less fearful. Exact figures are not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Neuroradiologist raters found low rates of hallucinations, omissions, and imprecisions in the simplified impressions compared with the originals.
links.quote: The reading grade of the report impressions decreased from approximately college to approximately middle-school level, and readability improved across several text complexity metrics.

links.comparator_used: Manual translation of simplified impressions, assessed by certified interpreters
links.outcome: Translation quality of Spanish translations of simplified impressions, as rated by certified interpreters
links.effect: Machine and manual translations were statistically indistinguishable; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: Machine generated translations of simplified impressions were statistically indistinguishable from manual translations as assessed by certified interpreters.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt and translation quality check
